concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 require the pipeline to produce a unified analysis-ready dataset. Task T018 ('WRITE DATASET') is marked unchecked [ ], meaning the critical step of persisting the harmonized dataset to `data/processed/harmonized_dataset.parquet` is missing from the implementation plan. Without this task, the downstream regression (US-2) has no input.

FR-005 (VIF calculation), FR-004 (interaction term extraction), and US-2 (regression results) require specific outputs. Tasks T023 (VIF), T024 (coefficients extraction), and T025 (save results) are all marked unchecked [ ]. The regression analysis cannot be completed or reported without these tasks.

FR-006 (bootstrapping), FR-007 (sensitivity analysis), and SC-004 (instability ratio) are core to US-3. Tasks T026-T032 are all marked unchecked [ ]. The robustness and sensitivity analysis required by the spec is entirely missing from the task list.

The plan assumes foundational infrastructure is complete, yet T001 (project structure), T002 (dependencies), T003 (linting), T004 (data dirs), T006 (pytest), and T009 (checksum utility) are marked unchecked [ ]. These are prerequisites for all user stories; their absence blocks the entire implementation.

FR-010 and SC-005 require the *entire* pipeline to complete within 6 hours. Task T032b is an 'Intermediate Monitoring' task that raises `SystemExit(1)` if 50% of the time limit is reached. This contradicts the spec's requirement to complete the full analysis, as it would abort the process prematurely before US-3 tasks (T028-T032) can run.

Task T014b references 'Cronbach's alpha' for reliability verification. While the spec mentions this in assumptions, the task description does not explicitly link to the specific FR or SC requiring this check, nor does it clarify if this is a hard stop for synthetic data generation (which is the primary path per plan.md). The tag `[US1]` is present, but the requirement mapping is implicit.

FR-007 requires sweeping thresholds for *both* working memory load AND discount rate. Task T029 mentions 'WM load threshold... and discount rate' but the description focuses heavily on WM. It lacks the explicit instruction to generate the full cross-combination of threshold sweeps (WM x Discount) required to fully satisfy the sensitivity analysis scope, risking incomplete coverage of FR-007.
